mapper.select:
SELECT jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, jp.TITLE AS title, jp.RECRUIT_COUNT AS recruitCount,
CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(jp.APPLICATION_PERIOD, ' ~ ', -1)), '%Y-%m-%d') >= CURDATE() THEN '진행중' ELSE '마감' END AS status,
COUNT(a.JOBSEEKER_APPLICANT_IDX) AS applicants
FROM job_posts jp LEFT JOIN jobseeker_applicant a ON a.JOB_POSTS_IDX = jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AND (a.STATUS IS NULL OR TRIM(a.STATUS) != 'SCRAP')
WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} GROUP BY jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX ORDER BY jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX DESC

SELECT a.JOBSEEKER_APPLICANT_IDX AS jobseekerApplicantIdx, a.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS name, ju.JOBSEEKER_EMAIL AS email, ju.JOBSEEKER_PHONE AS phone, DATE_FORMAT(a.APPLIED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS appliedDate, a.STATUS AS status, a.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx
FROM jobseeker_applicant a JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = a.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = a.JOBSEEKER_IDX
WHERE a.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} AND jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} AND (a.STATUS IS NULL OR TRIM(a.STATUS) != 'SCRAP')
AND a.STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY a.APPLIED_AT DESC

SELECT a.JOBSEEKER_APPLICANT_IDX AS jobseekerApplicantIdx, a.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS name, ju.JOBSEEKER_EMAIL AS email, ju.JOBSEEKER_PHONE AS phone, DATE_FORMAT(a.APPLIED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS appliedDate, a.STATUS AS status,
jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, jp.TITLE AS jobTitle,
cp.COVER_POSTS_IDX AS coverPostsIdx, cp.HOPE_JOB AS hopeJob, cp.HOPE_REGION AS hopeRegion, cp.EDUCATION AS education, cp.MILITARY_STATUS AS militaryStatus, cp.CAREER AS career, cp.KEYSKILL AS keyskill, cp.CERTIFICATION AS certification, cp.LANGUAGE_SKILL AS languageSkill, cp.APPLY_MOTIVE AS applyMotive, cp.GROWTH_PROCESS AS growthProcess, cp.PERSONALITY AS personality, cp.JOB_EXPERIENCE AS jobExperience, cp.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl
FROM jobseeker_applicant a JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = a.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = a.JOBSEEKER_IDX LEFT JOIN cover_posts cp ON cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX = a.JOBSEEKER_IDX
WHERE a.JOBSEEKER_APPLICANT_IDX = #{jobseekerApplicantIdx} AND jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}
